constraints.description: Draw on the app canvas over the target dots (goal-image pixel coordinates).
Continuous lines preferred: draw each line without lifting.

instructions:
1. The canvas shows the 41 dots of the target [CLM-01]. Draw on the canvas; the dots stay where they are.
2. The target is 1 continuous line with no loose ends [CLM-02, CLM-05]; try to draw each without lifting.
3. Pass through every dot the target line passes through, and keep dots the line leaves free untouched [CLM-04].
4. Stage C1.S1 - one suggested way (inferred), not the original drawing order: follow [CLM-06].
5. Stage C1.S2 - one suggested way (inferred), not the original drawing order: follow [CLM-07].
6. Stage C1.S3 - one suggested way (inferred), not the original drawing order: follow [CLM-08].
7. Stage C1.S4 - one suggested way (inferred), not the original drawing order: follow [CLM-09].
8. Stage C1.S5 - one suggested way (inferred), not the original drawing order: follow [CLM-10].
9. Stage C1.S6 - one suggested way (inferred), not the original drawing order: follow [CLM-11].
10. Stage C1.S7 - one suggested way (inferred), not the original drawing order: follow [CLM-12].
11. Stage C1.S8 - one suggested way (inferred), not the original drawing order: follow [CLM-13].
12. Check the finished drawing against the 8-fold symmetry of the target [CLM-03].
